name: Salary Scale A
description: Executive functions. Functions characterized by performing a limited number of simple and repetitive tasks (e.g. typing-only roles).

name: Salary Scale B
description: Support functions. Functions contributing to the achievement of a broader mission (e.g. administrative employee, receptionist).

name: Salary Scale C
description: Management functions. Functions consisting of a complete set of tasks forming a single mission (e.g. personnel admin, PC technician).

name: Salary Scale D
description: Advisory functions. Functions focused on monitoring and developing professional processes toward a specific objective (e.g. programmer, accountant, consultant).

name: Salary Scale 1
description: Basic execution functions (office assistant, débarrasseur, toilet attendant, distribution of drinks and bread).

name: Salary Scale 2
description: Support operational functions (commis, room attendants, kitchen assistants, bar support, logistics).

name: Salary Scale 3
description: Skilled execution functions (service staff, porters, grill operators, plongeurs).

name: Salary Scale 4
description: Qualified service and crew functions (cashiers, crew, café staff, demi-chef de rang).

name: Salary Scale 5
description: Experienced service and technical roles (chef de rang, barman, night auditor, supervisors).

name: Salary Scale 6
description: Specialized and supervisory functions (chefs de partie, concierge, sommelier, reception managers).

name: Salary Scale 7
description: Advanced technical and coordination roles (maintenance specialists, team leaders, chief concierge).

name: Salary Scale 8
description: Middle management and expert roles (assistant managers, sous-chefs, department coordinators).

name: Salary Scale 9
description: Senior management functions (head chef, general manager, FO manager, spa manager).

name: Salary Scale 81
description: Fishermen - Crew Member (excl. apprentice cabin boys)
